title: 2006 Raytheon ATFLIR patent and Gimbal rotation

tellings.quote: So and also this was uh a patent from I believe 2006.

plain: The rotation seen in the Gimbal video, a Navy clip of an object that appears to turn in the sky, can be traced to a Raytheon patent for the ATFLIR, the targeting camera pod carried on Navy jets. That is the argument of Mick West, a researcher who looks for ordinary explanations of UFO videos, and he makes it to Michels while saying the patent is from 2006, 'I believe'. He uses it to argue that the turning comes from how the camera works rather than from the object itself.
